guard_torch_init_functions: guard torch.nn.init primitives with _is_hf_initialized flag to prevent re-initialization of already loaded weights
no_init_weights: disable weight initialization at torch and transformers level to speed up empty model initialization with deepspeed
no_tie_weights: disable weight tying during from_pretrained to keep all weights accessible in the state_dict
meta_device_safe_creation_ops: patch torch.linspace to default device to cpu during meta-device model initialization for remote code safety
lecun_normal_: initialize tensors with LeCun normal variance scaling using truncated normal distribution and fan_in mode
